columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each project, crucial for tracking.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Unique dataset identifier, essential for dataset management.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Name of the dataset, used for identification.

columns.name: exists
columns.comment: Indicates if the dataset currently exists, boolean value.

columns.name: type
columns.comment: Type of data source, e.g., PostgreSQL, Snowflake.

columns.name: formatType
columns.comment: Data format type, such as CSV or JSON.

columns.name: params.connection
columns.comment: Connection type for data access, e.g., Snowflake.

columns.name: managed
columns.comment: Indicates if the dataset is managed, boolean value.

columns.name: params.mode
columns.comment: Mode of data access, typically 'table'.

columns.name: params.table
columns.comment: Table name pattern for data storage.

columns.name: params.schema
columns.comment: Schema name for database organization.

columns.name: params.path
columns.comment: File path for data storage and access.

columns.name: creationTag.lastModifiedBy.login
columns.comment: User who last modified the creation tag.

columns.name: creationTag.lastModifiedOn
columns.comment: Timestamp of last modification of creation tag.

columns.name: versionTag.lastModifiedBy.login
columns.comment: User who last modified the version tag.

columns.name: versionTag.lastModifiedOn
columns.comment: Timestamp of last modification of version tag.

columns.name: shortDesc
columns.comment: Brief description of the dataset's purpose.

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Detailed description of the dataset's contents.

columns.name: params.metastoreDatabaseName
columns.comment: Name of the metastore database for metadata.

columns.name: params.folderSmartId
columns.comment: Smart ID for folder organization.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Array of tags for categorizing datasets.

columns.name: featureGroup
columns.comment: Indicates if the dataset is a feature group, boolean.

columns.name: num_metrics_checks
columns.comment: Number of metric checks performed on the dataset.

columns.name: num_columns
columns.comment: Number of columns in the dataset.

columns.name: column_names
columns.comment: Array of column names in the dataset.
